description: This file defines the `SimpleMapProcess` class, which handles processing a collection of string operations on a specified field within a map, often based on XML configuration.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcess
classes.description: Handles processing of string operations defined by XML, applied to a specific field in a data map.

methods.name: SimpleMapProcess
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the process with configuration from an XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes all mapped string operations on the provided input map, updating results accordingly.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the field name that this process operates on.

methods.name: readOperations
methods.description: Reads child operation elements from the XML configuration and initializes the corresponding operation objects.
